sloka: दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः ।रामस्य हि महत् कार्यं मयेदं वितथीकृतम् ।। ५.५८.१५७ ।।।।
transliteration: dahatā ca mayā laṅkāṁ dagdhā sītā na saṁśayaḥ ।rāmasya hi mahat kāryaṁ mayedaṁ vitathīkṛtam ।। 5.58.157 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lanka has been burnt by me and Sita might have also been burnt. There is no doubt. The great purpose of Rama has been spoilt by me'.
